hooks.command: bash -c 'staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; then if ! echo "$staged" | grep -qE "\.(test|spec)\."; then echo "PIPELINE MODULE CHANGED WITHOUT TESTS. Staged pipeline files:"; echo "$staged" | grep -E "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; echo ""; echo "Commit checklist requires: write the failing test FIRST for these modules."; echo "Stage a test file, or use git commit with --no-verify if you have a reason."; exit 1; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Replace PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN with a regex matching your project's data pipeline modules. Example for SENDEX: (classification|findings_|derive-summaries|cross-domain-syndromes|syndrome-interpretation|findings-rail-engine|recovery-classification|finding-nature|protective-signal|lab-clinical-catalog)

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "Co-Authored-By"; then echo "BLOCKED: CLAUDE.md rule 5 -- never add Claude as co-author."; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" ]; then bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" "$FILE"; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Post-edit complexity spot-check. Runs complexity-check.sh on the edited file. Advisory warnings only — non-zero exit injects a warning into the agent context.
